definitions.selection: positive genes from full panel, descending expression with stable panel-order ties, top k, then shared-column projection
definitions.rank_weight: k minus zero-based rank within the full-panel positive-gene list; absent shared genes get zero
definitions.expression_values: h5ad.X as provided; no second normalisation
definitions.readout: source-only StandardScaler and Ridge of cosine/sine phase, frozen on target; all fits use float64
definitions.diagnostic_shared_first_rank: shared genes restricted before top-k selection, retaining original panel-order tie breaks; excluded from primary comparison
definitions.bootstrap: paired target-cell percentile intervals with fixed source fits; not source-sampling or cross-experiment uncertainty
definitions.bootstrap_fraction_positive: descriptive bootstrap proportion, not a calibrated hypothesis-test p-value
definitions.R_diff: absolute mean complex angular residual, invariant to a global rotation; not circular R-squared
definitions.constant_floor: a constant phase predictor; R_diff equals measured target concentration
definitions.identity_coverage_limit: expression arms use shared gene columns only; the model may also use nonshared gene identities
definitions.null_interval: CI spanning zero means unresolved difference; no equivalence margin or equivalence test is specified

cd34_dimensions.definition: Rows are genes; PR centers coordinate columns; TwoNN Euclidean MLE excludes zero/tied nearest distances; controls keep representation shape
